episodes.title: Yellow (6 Weeks Before the Heist)
episodes.summary: Leo assembles a team to steal billions in bonds from an impenetrable vault in New York City. Their first task: Secure seed money in the Diamond District.

episodes.title: Green (7 Years Before the Heist)
episodes.summary: A sobering diagnosis pushes Leo to break out of prison with help from a cellmate. After an emotional reunion on the outside, Leo begins plotting revenge.

episodes.title: Blue (5 Days Before the Heist)
episodes.summary: The team sets their intricate plan into motion amid news of a hurricane approaching the city. A paranoid Roger deals with a threat. The FBI gets a tip.

episodes.title: Orange (3 Weeks Before the Heist)
episodes.summary: Weeks before the heist, the squad hits a few obstacles as the FBI closes in on Ava and Bob copes with an injury. Agent Nazan seizes an opportunity.

episodes.title: Violet (24 Years Before the Heist)
episodes.summary: In the past, family man Leo tries to leave his life of crime behind, but a tempting job and a persuasive partner make old habits hard to break.

episodes.title: Red (The Morning After the Heist)
episodes.summary: Tensions run high when the crew regroups after the heist and questions what went wrong — and who to trust. FBI agent Nazan makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Pink (6 Months After the Heist)
episodes.summary: Now in hiding after the heist, the crew faces new struggles. Roger conspires with an unlikely partner. The feds chase a lead in South Carolina.

episodes.title: White (The Heist)
episodes.summary: A master criminal and his crew hatch an elaborate scheme to break into a secure vault, but are forced to pivot when things don't go according to plan.
